affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation code 097 recorded at Army entry on 21 April 1943; no employer, workplace, specific role, or OSS-entry date is named.

affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation code 685 recorded at Army entry on 8 December 1942; the category does not distinguish welding from flame cutting or name an employer or workplace.
affiliations.research_notes: Exact private-identifier and exact-name agreement confirm the indexed person. The official category supplies no named organization and does not establish the Army-to-OSS sequence.

claims.claim_text: John H. Craven's identifier-linked Army-entry record classified his civilian occupation as manager or official, not elsewhere classified; no employer is named.
claims.evidence_excerpt: 0-97. Managers and officials, n. e. c.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact-identifier Army row rendered GRAVEN JOHN H and carries occupation code 097, which the official code list defines as a broad managers-and-officials category.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the exact private identifier plus matching given name and middle initial; the one-letter surname conflict requires original-card review.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented at Army entry on 21 April 1943; it is not proven to be immediately before OSS service.
claims.match_notes: Occupation is not employer. The Army surname conversion discrepancy is visible and no silent correction is made.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index identifies Virginia Crate in Box 152 without a rank or private identifier. The official Army file has no exact-name row, and three newspaper OCR hits are produce-market phrases rather than a person.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 152 to identify Virginia Crate and establish her immediate pre-OSS affiliation and last civilian employer. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The exact indexed private identifier selects one Army row dated 21 April 1943 as a private. Its converted name reads GRAVEN JOHN H, preserving a one-letter surname conflict with indexed CRAVEN JOHN H; NARA documents conversion defects in the merged file.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 152 and the original Army card to confirm the Craven/Graven spelling, establish the Army-to-OSS sequence, and identify the managerial employer or role.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index and official Army merged file share William C. Craven's exact full name and exact private identifier. The alternate ERC row dates entry as a private to 8 July 1942; civilian-occupation value 417 remains deliberately undecoded.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 152 and the original Army card to establish the Army-to-OSS sequence and identify the pre-OSS employer or occupation; do not decode value 417 without clearer primary documentation.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index and official Army merged file share William M. Cravener's exact full name and exact private identifier. The Army row dates entry as a private to 8 December 1942 and records civilian occupation code 685.
